title: 8 qt steamer
text: 8 qt steamer. I have instant pots... but I actually purchased this for regular pots and steaming.  I have always had that really small stainless collapsible type of steamer - but they are never tall enough - in my opinion.  So I purchased this for my regular smaller stock pot.  Fits like a glove. I did actually purchase two, the 8 qt and the 3 qt.  So I'm covered.  I have read other reviews about the silicone leg tips coming off - so they tossed them - I have not had that problem.  But, having said that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. Note:  I do remove the silicone feet protectors if I wash in the dishwasher.

product_metadata.title: House Again Original Sturdy Steamer Basket for 8 Quart Pressure Cooker, 18/8 Stainless Steel Steamer Insert with Silicone Covered Handle, Great Accessory for Steaming Vegetables Fruits Eggs
features: Useful Accessory to Instapot - Perfect steamer basket for veggies, hard cooked eggs, you can also use it for fast straining when you are making bone broth & stocks.
Sturdier and easier to clean than the wire basket - All the parts including the handle, steamer insert and the trivet are made of quality 18/8 stainless steel. Dishwasher washable, easy to clean.

Larger Capacity - Designed to make full use of the available space. Fits 8 quart Instant Pot, as well as other larger electric pressure cooker. 1 inch trivet are high enough to keep above the water. Wide and holey baskets allow more ways for steam to penetrate the basket, easy to steam food evenly.

Silicone covered handle & legs make removal easy. The silicone part is 100% BPA free and food grade. *NOTE*: The black silicone sleeve on both ends of the handle is used to prevent scratching during transportation. Please REMOVE it before use for better installation into the hole.
